cohort: Newborns whose files were reviewed at Al-Zahra hospital in Guilan, Iran, between April 2018 and March 2019.
finding: 14.1% of neonates required resuscitation, with 10.2% needing basic and 3.9% advanced interventions, and this need was significantly associated with gestational age, meconium staining of amniotic fluid, mode of delivery, birth weight, multiple pregnancies, and Apgar scores at minutes 1 and 5.
mod_finding: 18.7% of infants born via cesarean delivery required resuscitation.
